retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 16 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1363643181, is an account of what the 1957 agreement classifies and how its annexes are revised; it argues the treaty out of nothing at all and names no event. It is a technical instrument of the UN Economic Commission for Europe, and a treaty that decided nothing this corpus holds has nothing here to be joined to — the reason §7.4 first named about environmental conventions and which applies unchanged to a road-haulage one.
